title: The ranch house, ii
logline: Tuesday. The half-acre. Gully's hemlocks. Wood walks the property line with him and the strip counts the trees the way it counted the blocks in 2000. Forty-one. Gully knows every one.

panels.composition: A half-acre of hemlock behind a small ranch house. GULLY walking the line. WOOD behind. BARNABY ahead.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man walking a property line through hemlock trees behind a small ranch house, a thin man following and a dog ahead

panels.composition: Gully's hand on a trunk. Then the next. He touches each one.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a stocky man's hand resting on a hemlock trunk

panels.composition: Wood counting under his breath. The strip's old habit.

balloons.text: I don't have to. I know them.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man counting trees under his breath while a stocky man answers without counting

panels.composition: The line's end. The house. Maria in the kitchen window. The dog at the door already. Forty-one trees between the road and a home. The strip very quiet.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small ranch house among hemlocks with a woman visible in the kitchen window and a dog waiting at the door, two men arriving from the trees, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now
